narration.prompt: [whispers] Bukas pa 'yung milk tea shop kagabi. Pero anim na buwan na pala itong sarado. [long pause] [softly] Rider ako. Alas-dos ng madaling-araw, may booking: dalawang milk tea, sa shop sa kanto. [long pause] Bukas ang ilaw. May pila. Lahat nakaharap sa counter. Walang gumagalaw. Walang nagsasalita. [long pause] Ngumiti ang crew. Hindi siya kumukurap. Inabot niya ang order ko, at ang resibo. [long pause] Paglabas ko, lumingon ako. Nakatingin silang lahat sa akin. Pero nakaharap pa rin ang katawan nila sa counter. [long pause] Kinabukasan, dumaan ako. Naka-kandado. Maalikabok. Anim na buwan na raw sarado, sabi ng guard. [long pause] Pero nasa bulsa ko pa ang resibo. Petsa kagabi. Alas-dos. [long pause] [whispers] Sa likod, may sulat-kamay: "Balik ka, sir. Kulang pa ang pila."

shop-loop.prompt: Inside a small empty milk tea shop at 2 a.m.: a refrigerator compressor humming, a fluorescent tube buzzing, a chiller ticking, a faint drip, total stillness, no music, no voices, eerie and lonely.

day-street.prompt: A busy street corner in Manila in the late morning: jeepneys and tricycles passing, distant horns, people walking, a vendor far away, warm daytime city ambience.

scooter.prompt: A small motorcycle scooter arriving on an empty street at night, slowing down, idling for a moment, then the engine switched off, silence after.

sealer.prompt: A milk tea cup sealing machine pressing a plastic film lid onto a cup: a mechanical clunk, a short hiss of heat, a click as it releases.

printer.prompt: A small thermal receipt printer printing a short receipt, a fast buzzing chatter, then the paper torn off.

padlock.prompt: A heavy padlock and chain on a rusty rolling metal shop shutter, rattled by a hand, the shutter shaking, metallic and dusty.
